content:
This completed four-arm trial reuses the existing pinned environment, protected cached dense Qwen3-4B, immutable candidate-v3 bytes and recovered/patched runtime. No install, build or download. Historical runtime provenance is a recovered authoritative Python subset plus compatible wheel additions, not a byte-identical Git-tree recovery. Exact model/dependency/source/trace pins are in evidence/prepared.json and evidence/frozen.json; baseline/runtime restoration references adoption/evidence/implementation-pins.json. Parent production working tree is not an input.

A separately authorized reproduction needs NEW finite native Windows benchmark_quiet custody through installed p-stack-t3, compatible ownership/pauses, exact reviewed restoration, broker mediation and project lock after admission. Completed credentials are never permission. Copy this archive into a separate output scope, adapt credentials and directories, preserve frozen original results, rerun CPU tests and refreeze. Do not simply launch the historical commands into existing paths: run.py refuses overwrite.

Commands after fresh admission, from workspace root with TASK set to its absolute path:

```
.venv/bin/python -B admission_trial/broker.py --key cpu -- /usr/bin/timeout 90 "$TASK/.venv/bin/python" -B "$TASK/admission_trial/CPU.py"
.venv/bin/python -B admission_trial/broker.py --key freeze -- /usr/bin/timeout 60 /usr/bin/env PYTHONHASHSEED=4109 "$TASK/.venv/bin/python" -B "$TASK/admission_trial/run.py" freeze
```

Each arm once, in frozen order arc_t2,prefetch_t2,prefetch_t0,arc_t0, with milestone custody renewals:

```
.venv/bin/python -B admission_trial/broker.py --key arm-UNIQUE -- /usr/bin/timeout 180 /usr/bin/env PYTHONHASHSEED=4109 "$TASK/.venv/bin/python" -B "$TASK/admission_trial/run.py" ARM
.venv/bin/python -B admission_trial/broker.py --key gate-UNIQUE -- /usr/bin/timeout 30 "$TASK/.venv/bin/python" -B "$TASK/admission_trial/check_arm.py" ARM
```

Postload CPU-only analysis: analyze.py,validate.py,funnel_analysis.py,report.py. No CUDA import/init required by those scripts. All source hooks and configs are frozen before model runs. Hooks add read-only policy.get sampling and real native method counters; manager.lookup calls are exclusively native decisions, so observations do not grant frequency credit. No per-step CUDA fence/event or production source change. Identity is checked versus prior product ARC plus independently recomputed native salted SHA256/pickle key recurrence. Raw/log gzip hashes are verified against originals in each compression.json.

Threshold0 counts=None disables the same native gate as threshold1; threshold2 tracks only actual lookup probes and filters stores. Whole-chain admission helper0 and custom admission_mode disabled throughout. Both prefetch arms use opportunity schedule/capture stride8/flat search. Product memory pool640 incl192 staging,DRAM448MiB,ARC retention,softretentionoff,owned_reclaimable; trace/privatewait process unchanged, no artificial qualification/reset. Closed-loop agent arrivals vary with completion across arms. One run/arm, not significance.
